s1.hook: Believe it or not, nutrition made an even bigger impact than working out.
s1.body: Taking my nutrition seriously made me look better and feel better, made me more productive, and made me more money. Today I don't eat anything until about 2 PM, then I start with a big salad, and every meal has a large serving of meat, fish, or eggs. I meal prep for about $8 or $9 a meal, which is less than ordering Chipotle. If you're in your 20s or 30s, start taking your nutrition seriously right now, because it's the biggest single factor in losing your belly fat.
s1.close: Leave a comment to let me know if you meal prep, and about what it costs you a meal.
s1.pinned_comment: I don't eat until about 2 PM, then I start with a big salad. What's the first thing you eat each day?

s2.hook: If you want to start working out, start with 5 minutes every day, first thing in the morning.
s2.body: Then step it up to 10 minutes, then 15, every day. You can start small and build it up, and once the habit is locked in, you'll be shocked at how much better your life gets. That's why I still work out first thing in the morning, 7 days a week. Working out made me healthier, made me feel better, made me more productive, and made my dating life better.
s2.close: Leave a comment to let me know how many minutes you're starting with.
s2.pinned_comment: I still work out first thing in the morning, 7 days a week. What time do you usually work out?

s3.hook: I strongly believe that every man should train in some kind of martial art.
s3.body: Every man should be able to protect himself and his family, and most men today can't. I dedicated about 20 years to training, invested in private lessons, and earned my black belt, and it made me a better person in so many ways. It made me better at dealing with conflict, and I get far less frustrated when things get complicated. I personally love Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, but you can do Muay Thai, Judo, or another martial art that appeals to you more.
s3.close: Leave a comment to let me know which martial art you train, or which one you want to start.
